items.description: The US Onyx Black EXAM44055B is a one-touch Rivelia with two removable 8.8 oz hoppers, a 13-setting built-in burr grinder, Bean Adapt guidance, a 3.5-inch touchscreen, four user profiles and included LatteCrema Hot.
items.bestFor: A US household alternating regular and decaf beans often enough to value labeled removable hoppers
